name: Love Mythos: Origins
source:
Set during the heyday of crumbling Fey-Human relations, Love Mythos: Origins is a love story that explores sacrifice, and just how powerful the hand of destiny is. You, the main character, are on a journey to a new land, looking for a new start. Along your way, you run into a sphinx whose smile is just as quick as his wit, and a mysterious woman named Nyssa, who is more than meets the eyes. ...Or all three eyes.

[Edited from [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=50&t=42913]Lemma Soft Forum thread[/url]]
translation:
《爱之神话：起源》以精灵与人类关系逐渐崩溃的鼎盛时期为背景，是一段探索牺牲与命运之手究竟有多强大的爱情故事。你是主人公，踏上前往新大陆的旅程，寻找新的开始。途中，你遇见了笑容如机敏头脑般迅速的斯芬克斯，以及名叫妮莎的神秘女人，她远比表面看起来复杂。……或者说，比三只眼睛看起来的还要复杂。

[据[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=50&t=42913]Lemma Soft论坛帖子[/url]编辑]
